QUOTE: The sanitizer components in `tests/scripts/components-sanitizers.sh` and `components-configuration-crypto.sh` build with `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` or `_MEMSAN`. `TEST_CF_SECRET()` marks secret inputs as uninitialised, so Valgrind or MemorySanitizer reports any branch or memory index that depends on them.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the MemSan/Valgrind testing, but it never says the facility is off by default or that it is explicitly not part of the library API.
